purpose: A declarative, provenance-first operational validation pack for an expandable company cohort. It starts with NVDA, AMD, MSFT, AAPL, and AMZN, and includes one real AMD amendment pair.
storage_rule: This file contains identities, availability, and assertions only. It never embeds SEC packages, Layer 1 snapshots, or generated Parquet publications.
local_layer1_evidence_rule: Each AVAILABLE company records the immutable run and snapshot that prove its own availability. A company-level snapshot never by itself proves that a common multi-company operational publication exists.

required_assertions: The original and amendment remain distinct accession-level evidence records.
An amendment is not assumed to contain every original fact; absent facts are not fabricated or copied into the amendment.
AS_FILED and LATEST_REPORTED selection must retain the selected accession, filed date, form, and source fact lineage.
The pack does not infer an amendment sequence number from accession text or numeric order.

publication_gate.fail_closed_condition: Every requested CIK must have an immutable Layer 1 snapshot in one declared input run, and all four roots must attest that identical CIK scope and run fingerprint. Otherwise no five-company operational comparison is served.
publication_gate.current_status: BLOCKED: all five companies have individual Layer 1 evidence, but it spans two input runs and no five-company parquet-operational-v1 root set attests one identical CIK scope and Layer 1 fingerprint.

acceptance_hypotheses.expected: The cohort is defined by company records and CIKs, not a hard-coded three-company query path. Any company is served only after the publication gate attests it.

All five companies are marked AVAILABLE only with their declared immutable Layer 1 snapshot. Their availability does not permit a five-company comparison until the separate publication gate attests one identical input scope and fingerprint.
AMD 10-K 0000002488-26-000018 and 10-K/A 0000002488-26-000021 remain separately identifiable and never overwrite one another in Raw or operational lineage.
T8 may mark only exact compatible standard taxonomy identities EQUIVALENT. Company-custom values and distinct standard QNames remain UNRESOLVED without a reviewed mapping.
